README: Declared coverage contract (proposal-integration-test-rework §5.6).
This file is HAND-AUTHORED from the §7 assignment tables and says which
(machine x system x card x geometry x depth x addressing) cells the
integration suite is REQUIRED to cover, and which directory owes each
one. It is never generated from a test run: a contract derived from what
happened would be satisfied by whatever happened, and the one question it
exists to answer — did a later change silently narrow coverage? — would
become unanswerable.
The achieved side is the @@COV records suite rows emit at runtime, read
from the live machine. Diff the two with:
make -C tests/integration test TIER=matrix 2>&1 | tee run.log
python3 scripts/test-matrix.py --check run.log
Check semantics:
declared and covered ......  ok
Cells owed by a test in a DIFFERENT tier than the one being checked are
reported separately, not as regressions — pass --tier=<unit|matrix|extended>
so a PR-tier run is not blamed for extended-tier cells. The owing tier is
read from the directory's own config.mk, so it cannot drift.
`blocked` reasons cite proposal-emulator-bug-fixes.md, which lives under
the gitignored local/ tree; docs/notes/2026-07-28-emulator-defects-from-
test-rework.md is the tracked index of the same eight entries and names
each one's in-tree guard.
declared, NOT covered .....  FAILS (coverage regressed)
covered, not declared .....  warning: claim it so it becomes protected
Three declared-but-uncovered cases are warnings rather than failures,
because none of them means coverage regressed:
suite:<dir> does not exist   the owing suite is not built yet. Derived
from the filesystem, so it cannot be faked.
blocked: <reason>           an emulator defect makes the cell
unreachable — see
proposal-emulator-bug-fixes.md. This is the
cell-level twin of a milestone row.
media_gated: true           the row skipped because private test data is
absent from this checkout (§9's
landable-before-data rule).
DELIBERATELY NOT DECLARED YET — the §7 passes still to land bring their
cells with them, and declaring them against directories that already exist
would report them as regressions rather than as work in progress:
* the IIcx card-family cells (iicx-824gc accel/decline boots,
iicx-gsvrom, iicx-video-modes' 16-cell sweep and the 8 cells that
re-host to suite-iix)
* extended-tier app/diagnostic re-hosts beyond the ones listed below
* the 6.0.8 rationalization's IIcx and IIfx floppy/HD split
Under-declaration is stated here on purpose: it is visible in review
rather than silently missing from the diff.
